name: Wirestay
description: Hold the cord taut between both fists across the chest to block a shove or low swing.

name: Tripping Slipknot
description: Flip an open loop over a held wrist and jerk the slack out to close it.

name: Noosering Blow
description: Snap both fists apart so the taut cord slaps hard across the target's collarbone.

name: Cordhandle Amble
description: Roll each foot heel to toe behind a walking target so gravel never scuffs.

name: Tripping Gripdowel
description: Drop the loop over the head from behind and stop it at the chin to lock the shoulders.

name: Cinchhit
description: Lean back with the loop seated at the throat line and let body weight keep the pull steady.

name: Strandstay
description: Seat the wooden toggle deep in the palm and cross the forearms to cover the face.

name: Constrict Husk
description: Wrap the cord twice about thumb and toggle so a sudden yank cannot rip it away.

name: Togglehusk
description: Cross the wrists to throw the loop over a head, then uncross to close it.

name: Sharp Tighten
description: Swing the hardwood toggle in a short downward knock against the back of the opponent's hand.

name: Solid Cordbraid
description: Twist the cord-wrapped wrist against the grabber's thumb to break a seizing hold.

name: Quiet Garrote
description: Shuffle sideways with both toggles at belt height so the cord stays ready and level.

name: Forward Barbedwire
description: Pull both toggles in toward the belt and hold, keeping the cord drawn across the neck.

name: Hitching Handlebar
description: Shape a fist-sized loop with one twist of the wire and pinch it shut around a wrist.

name: Cinchamble
description: Gather trailing wire in a figure eight over the palm while stepping clear of the target.

name: Noosepause
description: Wind the wire once about the forearm so the arm can be raised as a short protective bar.

name: Open Throttle
description: Draw the wire back at the target's nape with a straight spine, stepping back to keep the line tight.

name: Togglewedge
description: Flick the loop loose in one wrist snap when a grab is coming, leaving nothing to seize.

name: Shifting Wirecore
description: Lunge a long step forward with the cord already looped and both hands low and ready.

name: Cinchpace
description: Crouch tight against a corner and hold still until the target's shoulder passes the edge.

name: Locking Slipnoose
description: Lift the loop high and drop it over the target's head from the near side.

name: Strandstrike
description: Cross the forearms behind the target's nape and pull both hands outward against the cord.

name: Strandcowl
description: Brace an elbow into the target's back and turn the body to slip a flailing arm.

name: Settled Wirebraid
description: Roll across the shoulder blade when pulled down and keep both toggles in hand.

name: Pushing Toggle
description: Step backward in three short drags, hauling the cord so the target is pulled off balance.

name: Wirebump
description: Sink to one knee with the loop drawn tight, keeping the target bent and unable to stand.

name: Straight Cinch
description: Set a knuckle against the spine and heave the short cord back like a lever.

name: Barbedwire Cowl
description: Pull with the hips rather than the arms, drawing the cord home and holding it closed.

name: Slipknot Cowl
description: Roll the wrapped wrist upward to take a punch on the cord-covered forearm.

name: Swaying Constrict
description: Pivot on the ball of the foot to keep the cord behind the target's turning shoulder.

name: Slipnoose Bump
description: Press a knee against the lower back and keep the cord taut until the target slumps.

name: Noosering Wedge
description: Pinch the cord to the palm, then release at once so a clutching hand slides off.

name: Gripdowel Bump
description: Run a thread of qi along the cord and snap it taut across the target's wrist.

name: Wirewedge
description: Warm the cord with steady qi so it holds its line against a slapping blade.

name: Fixing Garrote
description: Let a pulse of qi stiffen the open loop so it settles over the neck without catching hair.

name: Quick Toggle
description: Match each pull of the cord to an exhale and keep qi flowing through both fists.

name: Wireamble
description: Gather qi at the soles to cross a gap behind the target without a sound.

name: Raised Cordhandle
description: Turn the taut cord across the line of a stabbing arm and push the point wide.

name: Togglestay
description: Anchor the cord on a set hip and let qi hold the loop closed while the hands shift grip.

name: Strandhit
description: Hold the breath through a long steady pull so qi stays settled in the forearms.

name: Wiredash
description: Snap the cord taut on a sharp exhale to carry the force of the whole body.

name: Sideways Wirebraid
description: Take a step only on each slack breath, tightening in when the opponent's chest rises.

name: Folded Wirecore
description: Catch a thrown fist on the loosened cord and let it slide off along the line.

name: Nabbing Throttle
description: Pass the loop over the head on an in-breath and close it on the out-breath.

name: Ready Cordbraid
description: Wind the cord up the forearm in even turns so it armors the arm as a guard.

name: Flat Tighten
description: Unwind the forearm turns in one flick so the free end whips across the face.

name: Stopping Wirecore
description: Wrap the cord twice about a wrist and pin that arm against the target's side.

name: Cinch Wedge
description: Spiral the cord down a gripped arm and draw it tight above the elbow.

name: Nooseamble
description: Circle the target in a tight coil of steps while the cord winds about one shoulder.

name: Sudden Garrote
description: Charge each wound turn with a trace of qi so the coil grips harder the longer it is held.

name: Sudden Noosering
description: Slide the loop beneath a raised guard to reach the throat the arms fail to cover.

name: Tight Wirebraid
description: Tuck the wound end into the fist so a snatching hand finds nothing to grab.

name: Quick Slipnoose
description: Draw the cord from a low posture, hands crossing at the hip, to bite across the throat.

name: Angled Handlebar
description: Raise the taut cord overhead to catch a descending cut on its braided strands.

name: Nooselid
description: Slip the loop around a wrist and twist it into a lock that turns the palm outward.

name: Strandamble
description: Walk half a pace behind the target and stay in the blind angle past the shoulder.

name: Slipknot Dash
description: Hold qi in the cord to keep the pull smooth while the target twists to escape.

name: Fixing Barbedwire
description: Yank the cord down at the collar to break the target's balance as a strike begins.

name: Level Handlebar
description: Feed slack to a struggling target, then pull it back suddenly to tighten the loop.

name: Constrict Hop
description: Judge the cord's reach in one glance and step so the loop falls an arm's length away.

name: Strandpause
description: Bunch the slack into a wad in the fist that smothers a clumsy knife jab.

name: Catching Toggle
description: Throw a hooked fold of slack over an arm and pull to bring the opponent down.

name: Cordhandle Hit
description: Snap the cord taut so its hard line cracks against the back of an extended hand.

name: Holding Cordbraid
description: Slide the taut cord up a blade's flat to push a thrust off the body line.

name: Sideways Gripdowel
description: Drag the cord low behind the retreating foot to trip a pursuer.
